title: Don't Be Ashamed to Say "I Don't Know": The Power of Honesty
summary: An exploration of how admitting uncertainty builds trust and authority in engineering teams, drawing parallels to psychological safety and the importance of honest communication over false confidence in decision-making.
when-to-read: Read this when you're struggling with how to handle uncertainty or gaps in knowledge within your team or role, or when you want to understand how honesty contributes to team dynamics. If you're specifically looking for frameworks to measure or build psychological safety metrics, consult articles on team effectiveness and observability instead.
